y-m-72-03.topic: Matsayin haraji bisa mataki da kuɗin shiga bayan haraji (ƙa’idar ci gaba)
y-m-72-03.goal: Yi amfani da daidai cewa idan an wuce iyakar mataki, sabon kaso yana aiki ne kawai ga abin da ya wuce iyakar, ba ga kuɗin shiga gaba ɗaya ba; ƙirƙiri misalai da kanka inda kuɗin bayan haraji ke ƙaruwa duk da cewa matsakaicin kaso ya tashi.
y-m-72-03.material:
Ga ƙa’idar harajin kuɗin shiga ta hasashe da aka ƙirƙira don wannan aiki (ba dokar haraji ta gaske ba). Ana raba kuɗin shiga na shekara (a 만원) zuwa matakai, kuma kaso na kowane mataki yana aiki ga adadin da ya shiga matakin kawai.
- Sashe har zuwa 4,000만원: 10%
- Sashe sama da 4,000만원 har zuwa 8,000만원: 20%
- Sashe sama da 8,000만원: 30%
Haraji jimillar harajin sassan uku ne; kuɗin bayan haraji kuwa kuɗin shiga a cire haraji. Seoyun ta warware ta ce, “Da zarar ka wuce 4,000만원 kaso ya zama 20%, don haka a zahiri kana asara.”

Wannan aiki matakin gabatarwa ne.

y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.b: Ragewa ya fi komai zabin Y; a kowane hali ribar ragewa ta fi.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.b: Idan Y ya riqe, ragewar X tana ba da 80, fiye da 60 na riqewa; idan Y ya rage, X yana samun 40 maimakon 30.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.c: Riqewa ya fi komai zabin Y. Idan dukkansu sun riqe, ribar 60 ce, mafi girma.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.c: 60 idan dukkansu sun riqe ribar X da Y ce tare. Idan Y ya rage, X yana samun 30 kawai ta riqewa.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.o.d: Teburin kadai ba zai nuna ko ya danganta da zabin Y ba.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.r.d: Idan ka raba zabin Y zuwa yanayi biyu, za ka ga wane zabin ke ba X babbar riba a kowane yanayi.
y-m-72-12.s.s1.explain: Idan Y ya riqe, ragewar X (80) ta fi riqewa (60); idan Y ya rage, ragewa (40) ta fi riqewa (30). Komai abin da Y ya yi, ragewa ya fi. Y ma yana da tsari iri daya, don haka idan dukkansu suka rage ribar (40, 40) ce, ko da yake riqewar su biyun ta ba da (60, 60).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.prompt: Ka kirkiri wani tebur mai tsari iri daya. T ita ce ribar X idan X kadai ya rage, R idan dukkansu sun riqe, P idan dukkansu sun rage, S idan X kadai ya riqe (Y kadai ya rage). Dole T > R > P > S, kuma T+S ya yi kasa da 2R. Kirkiri rukuni biyu daban na lambobi hudu da suka bambanta da sama. (Cikakkun lambobi daga 0 zuwa 100)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta jerin girman lambobi hudu na teburin sama.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.hint.1: Canza lambobi kana kiyaye jerin, sannan ka lissafa ka duba sharadin karshe (2R idan aka kwatanta da T+S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.T: Ribar X idan X kadai ya rage (T)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.R: Ribar X idan dukkansu sun riqe (R)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.P: Ribar X idan dukkansu sun rage (P)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.var.S: Ribar X idan X kadai ya riqe (S)
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c1: Dukkan lambobi hudu cikakku ne daga 0 zuwa 100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Yi lambobi hudu cikakku daga 0 zuwa 100.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Ribar T daga ragewa kadai ta fi R na riqewar duka.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c2: T bai fi R ba. Idan daya ya riqe, ragewa dole ya fi riba.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c3: Riqewar duka (R) ta fi ragewar duka (P).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c3: R bai fi P ba. Idan dukkansu suka rage, dole ribar duka ta ragu.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c4: Ragewar duka (P) ta fi riqewar daya kadai (S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c4: P bai fi S ba. Idan dayan ya rage, ragewa ma dole ya fi riba.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c5: Jimillar riqewar duka (2R) ta fi jimillar idan daya kadai ya rage (T+S).
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c5: 2R bai fi T+S ba. Jimillar riqewar duka dole ta fi.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.ok.c6: Wadannan lambobi sun bambanta da teburin sama.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.fail.c6: Lambobin iri daya ne da na teburin sama. Yi amfani da wasu lambobi.
y-m-72-12.s.s2.explain: Idan T>R>P>S kamar (70, 50, 20, 10), kuma 2R=100 ya fi T+S=80, tsarin labarin iri daya ne. Kowane shago yana cin riba idan ya rage, amma idan dukkansu suka rage ribar ta yi kasa da riqewar duka.
